translation: You are the leaf-green moon, you indeed, you indeed... You have no blemish at all, none at all, none at all... What miracle does the moon up in the sky hold in his hand... You have the miracle of drawing rice from the very soil... He belongs among the stars of the sky, you belong among the beads of sweat... He belongs among the stars of the sky, you belong among the beads of sweat... You are the leaf-green moon, you indeed, you indeed... You have no blemish at all, none at all, none at all...

When the rainy season comes, clouds cover it and the moon's smile fades away... When the rainy season comes, clouds cover it and the moon's smile fades away... In the rains and the floods, splashed with mud, you are the dim moon... In the rains and the floods, splashed with mud, you are the dim moon... He is the beauty of the clouds, you are the brilliance of the wet paddy fields... He is the beauty of the clouds, you are the brilliance of the wet paddy fields... You are the leaf-green moon, you indeed, you indeed... You have no blemish at all, none at all, none at all...

The full-moon lamp changes its colour every single day... The full-moon lamp changes its colour every single day... Every hour it bends into a new shape, worn down by mounting hardships... Every hour it bends into a new shape, worn down by mounting hardships... He is the crescent of the moonless night, you are the crescent that goes hungry and fasting... He is the crescent of the moonless night, you are the crescent that goes hungry and fasting... You are the leaf-green moon, you indeed, you indeed... You have no blemish at all, none at all, none at all...

As toiling souls, you cultivate both the earth and the sky... As toiling souls, you cultivate both the earth and the sky... Even when the fruit of your labour never reaches your hand, you remain tireless karma-yogis... Even when the fruit of your labour never reaches your hand, you remain tireless karma-yogis... He is the sky's beloved butter, you are the earth's very backbone... He is the sky's beloved butter, you are the earth's very backbone... You are the leaf-green moon, you indeed, you indeed... You have no blemish at all, none at all, none at all... What miracle does the moon up in the sky hold in his hand... You have the miracle of drawing rice from the very soil... He belongs among the stars of the sky, you belong among the beads of sweat... He belongs among the stars of the sky, you belong among the beads of sweat... You are the leaf-green moon, you indeed, you indeed... You have no blemish at all, none at all, none at all...
summaryEn: This song addresses a farmer or farm labourer as a "leaf-green moon," building an extended contrast between the moon in the sky and the toiling farmer on earth. Across the pallavi and three verses, the moon's beauty is repeatedly held up next to the farmer's sweat and endurance: the sky-moon holds no real power, while the farmer performs the true miracle of drawing food from bare soil. Each verse pairs a seasonal or celestial image - rain clouds hiding the moon, the moon's changing daily phases, the waxing and waning crescent - with the farmer's hardship through floods, mud, hunger and unrewarded toil, addressing him as a tireless "karma-yogi." Belonging to the Agrarian category, it is a devotional-style praise song that elevates farm labour to a sacred, cosmic status, using nature imagery familiar to a farming community, with the pallavi returning like a refrain after every verse to frame the whole song as one continuous comparison between the distant, idle moon and the laboring farmer beneath it.
summaryTe: ఈ పాట ఒక రైతును లేదా వ్యవసాయ కూలీని "ఆకు పచ్చ చందమామ"గా సంబోధిస్తూ, ఆకాశంలోని చందమామకు, భూమిపై కష్టపడే రైతుకు మధ్య పోలిక చేస్తుంది. పల్లవిలో మరియు మూడు చరణాలలో చందమామ అందాన్ని రైతు చెమటతో, ఓర్పుతో పోలుస్తూ, ఆకాశపు చందమామకు నిజమైన శక్తి ఏమీ లేదని, మట్టి నుండి అన్నం తీసే నిజమైన మహిమ రైతుదేనని చెబుతుంది. ప్రతి చరణంలో వర్షాకాలంలో మేఘాలు చందమామను కప్పడం, రోజురోజుకూ మారే చందమామ ఆకారం, అమావాస్య-పున్నమి వంటి ఖగోళ చిత్రాలను, వరదలు, బురద, ఆకలి, ఫలితం దక్కని కష్టం వంటి రైతు కష్టాలతో జతచేసి, అతన్ని అలుపెరుగని కర్మయోగిగా అభివర్ణిస్తుంది. వ్యవసాయ కేటగిరీకి చెందిన ఈ పాట, రైతు శ్రమను ఒక పవిత్రమైన, విశ్వస్థాయి విషయంగా ఎత్తి చూపే భక్తిపూర్వక శైలి పాట. ప్రతి చరణం తర్వాత పల్లవి పునరావృతమవుతూ, దూరంగా నిష్క్రియంగా ఉండే చందమామకు, కింద కష్టపడే రైతుకు మధ్య పోలికను పాట పొడవునా కొనసాగిస్తుంది.
